typography.scope: Actual TypographyState, TypographyScope and sidebar policy against synthetic controls; includes explicit setter self-assignment, external changes, rollback and nested measure/draw lifecycle.
typography.limitation: No Unity native measurements, Harmony constructor/setter patch execution, pixels or physical input. Those require the Studio acceptance run.

limitations: Catalog timings are .NET/Windows helper measurements, not game FPS.
GDI candidates are additionally filtered by actual Unity OS font names in the running game.
Common Chinese sample coverage is not complete rare-character coverage.
TTC non-first faces, variable fonts and mismatched native/file faces remain excluded.
Default font override, bold and size delta are off/off/0; optional effects still require real F1 and sidebar acceptance.
